title: ReLay: Bidirectional Layout-Code Translation and Library Evolution for Reusable and Process-Portable Analog Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.25328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog layout generators provide a programmable interface for design reuse and process migration, but their coverage is limited by handcrafted libraries. The designer knowledge embedded in complete layouts remains implicit in their geometry, making it difficult to capture in reusable generator libraries. We present ReLay, a bidirectional layout-code framework that recovers generator programs from existing layouts, enabling cross-PDK portability and parametric resizing of existing designs. Constructions that recur across recovered programs are promoted to library functions, so the library evolves as layouts accumulate. We also introduce the first layout-code benchmark: 1,050 hand-drawn layouts from 27 circuit families across three open-source PDKs, ranging from primitive cells to full chips. Learned functions account for 53-66% of layout-building calls in held-out layouts, demonstrating reuse beyond the learning corpus. Frontier LLM age

translated_title: ReLay：面向可复用且工艺可移植的模拟设计的双向版图-代码翻译与库演化
translated_abstract: 模拟版图生成器为设计复用和工艺迁移提供了可编程接口，但其覆盖范围受限于手工构建的库。完整版图中蕴含的设计师知识仍然隐含在其几何结构中，难以被捕获到可复用的生成器库中。我们提出了ReLay，一个双向的版图-代码框架，能够从现有版图中恢复生成器程序，实现跨PDK的可移植性以及现有设计的参数化尺寸调整。在恢复的程序中反复出现的构造会被提升为库函数，因此库随着版图的积累而不断演化。我们还引入了首个版图-代码基准测试：包含来自三个开源PDK、27个电路系列的1,050个手工绘制版图，范围从基本单元到完整芯片。学习到的函数在保留测试版图中占版图构建调用的53-66%，展示了超越学习语料库的复用能力。
tldr: 提出了双向版图-代码转换框架ReLay，可从现有版图自动恢复生成器程序并让函数库随版图积累而演化，同时发布了首个版图-代码基准数据集，实现模拟设计的复用与跨工艺节点移植。
en_tdlr: ReLay is a bidirectional layout-code framework that recovers generator programs from existing layouts and evolves reusable function libraries over time, enabling analog design reuse and cross-PDK portability, supported by the first layout-code benchmark of 1,050 hand-drawn layouts.
